metadata.title: BGA — board game rules assistant
metadata.description: A local voice assistant that teaches board game rules from your own rulebooks.

home.title: Board game rules assistant
home.subtitle: Answers come only from the rulebooks, FAQs and errata indexed on this computer.

rulebooks.title: Rulebooks
rulebooks.subtitle: Load your own publisher PDFs on this computer. Nothing from someone else’s library is bundled.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.subtitle: We check this computer and recommend a model profile. Page citation quality is the same on every profile — smaller machines only trade fluency for speed.

browserOnly.title: Model setup needs the desktop app
browserOnly.body: Checking hardware and downloading models works in the packaged desktop app. In the browser, open Rulebooks to import a PDF — start the stack with pnpm dev first.

profile.sharedRetrieval: Search and reranking models are identical on every profile, so the cited rulebook page stays equally accurate.
profile.diskNeed: About {{gib}} GB of disk will be used after models are downloaded.

minimal-16gb.title: Recommended: minimal (16 GB class)
minimal-16gb.body: A smaller language model. Answers stay grounded in the same pages, but wording is simpler, teaching is weaker, and “I don’t know” appears more often.

starter-32gb.title: Recommended: starter (32 GB class)
starter-32gb.body: The default build profile. Good balance of speed and explanation quality for settling rules at the table.

full-64gb.title: Recommended: full (64 GB class)
full-64gb.body: Largest local models, including an optional vision model later. Best fluency for teaching a new game out loud.

reason.full: This machine has enough memory for the full profile.
reason.starter: This machine matches the starter profile.
reason.minimal: This machine fits the minimal profile comfortably.
reason.insufficient_disk: Free disk space is low for the recommended profile. Free space before downloading models.
reason.insufficient_memory: Memory is below the comfortable minimum. The minimal profile is still offered, but answers may be slow or truncated.

ollama.missingBody: The language models run through Ollama on this computer. Use Install and download below.
ollama.download: Download Ollama (opens in a new tab)

models.title: Model download
models.body: Models are downloaded with a visible progress step so the app never looks frozen. The installer itself stays small; the weights are several gigabytes.

runtime.osPromptMac: When Ollama’s installer opens, macOS may ask you to confirm. That is expected — allow it so Ollama can install.
runtime.macDragToApplications: If a disk image window appears, drag Ollama into Applications. Stay in this app — we start Ollama for you.
runtime.ignoreOllamaTerminal: If Ollama shows a window asking you to type something in Terminal, close that window. You do not need Terminal for this app.
runtime.osPromptWindows: When the Ollama installer opens, Windows may show a permission prompt. That is expected — allow it so Ollama can install.
runtime.readyBody: Everything is ready — opening the assistant…

error.download_failed: Could not download the Ollama installer. Check your internet connection, then try again.
error.ollama_timeout: Ollama did not become ready in time. Finish the Ollama install, open Ollama once, then try again.
error.pull_failed: Could not download the models. Keep this app open, check that Ollama is running, then try again.
error.search_timeout: Models are present, but search did not finish starting. Close the app and open it again.
error.runtime_failed: Something went wrong during setup. Try again. If it keeps failing, close the app and open it again.

setup.continueDisabledHint: Tap Install and download once. When it finishes, the assistant opens by itself.

pdfImport.title: Add a rulebook PDF
pdfImport.subtitle: You always load your own PDFs. Nothing from someone else’s library is bundled. Answers from those documents arrive in the next stage — for now the file is turned into searchable pages on this computer.

howAdding.helper: A second booklet, solo mode, or late supplement belongs under an existing game — use “Add to an existing game”. A new box or an expansion you bought later is a new game.

attachGame.selectDescription: Choose the game this PDF belongs to

gameId.label: Game id
gameId.description: Lowercase slug used as the folder name, for example azul or brass-birmingham

gameTitle.label: Game title
gameTitle.description: Shown in the game list. Defaults to the game id if left blank.

baseGame.label: This is an expansion of
baseGame.description: Optional. Leave empty for a standalone or base game. Only base games appear here.

documentTitle.label: Document title
documentTitle.description: A short name people understand, for example Rulebook, Solo mode, or Living rules May 2024
documentTitle.requiredAttach: Required when adding to an existing game

communityFaq.label: Also fetch BoardGameGeek description text
communityFaq.description: Uses the official XML API only. Never downloads rulebook PDFs from BGG Files. Needs internet; skipping it never blocks the PDF import.

drop.title: Drop a PDF here
drop.body: Drag a publisher rulebook onto this area, or choose a file. Pages are rendered and text is split into sections on this computer.
drop.keyboardHint: To add a file with the keyboard, use Choose PDF.

pdfImport.busy: Reading how the pages are laid out, then turning them into searchable sections…

success.title: Rulebook imported
